name: IC Power Converter — 3V — Converter
description: Through-hole 3V IC power converter cluster featuring Vigortronix VTX-214 series AC-DC converter footprints.
selection_hints: Select between VTX-214-010-1xx and VTX-214-015-1xx footprint variants based on PCB design requirements.
Prefer Tier A parts such as VTX-214-015-103 over Tier B parts.
Verify compatibility with 3V through-hole AC-DC power converter footprints.
avoid_when: Surface mount mounting is required instead of through-hole mounting.
The circuit requires a power converter voltage other than 3V.
The PCB design requires footprints outside the Vigortronix VTX-214 converter series.
